SUBJECT: Roms and Proms - Self Testing
The Sea Wolf micro-computer system has been programmed to detect a defective prom. To utilize the test, proceed as follows:
(1) Set switches #6, #7, and #8 to the 'Off' position (PC 596-904).
(4) When a prom is defective internally, a letter will appear displayed on the TV screen locating the faulty prom (PC 80-900).
(5) When all proms are good, the TV screen will display nothing but the waves.
(6) Return switches #6, #7, and #8 to normal positions.
(7) Activate tilt switch to return game to normal operation.
The above test will not function when the program test itself is defective or a prom fault is external.
